scope: User-authorized left dock factory/default-reset width: 300 to 360 logical pixels.
behavior: Fresh/factory layout and Reset Menus use 360 outer logical pixels. Existing persisted custom sizes still reload. Right dock remains 300. Existing icon scale at a given width retained by separating its 300-point reference width from the startup default.

build.command: cargo rustc -p om9-app --bin om9 --target-dir L:/om9-target -j 2 -- -o L:/om9-target/debug/om9-dock-360.exe

tests.execution: Fresh integration executables in L:/om9-target/debug/deps were run directly after cargo test hit the running om9.exe lock; default-restore suite rerun after changing the two fixture oracles. cargo test -p om9-app --target-dir L:/om9-target -j 2 --lib dock_layout -- --test-threads=1 passed all 16 library cases.

validator: Updated the stale icon constants and included the existing screen-size scaling in the oracle; no production icon size rule changed. Self-test: 5 good receipts accepted, 18 doctored receipts rejected.

public_source_audit.note: Existing private/reference/binary/raster artifacts; no new reference assets.

limitations: Saved custom layouts retain their widths until Reset Menus or a manual resize.

proposed_skill_text: Dock trái mặc định rộng 360 px logic (tính cả khung) khi tạo layout mới và Reset Menus. Tiếp tục khôi phục chiều rộng người dùng đã lưu; dock phải giữ mặc định 300 px.
